overview.title: مركز روحي داخل الأسوار
overview.p1: المسجد الكبير جزء من هوية مدينة تارودانت. الزوار غير المسلمين يشاهدونه عادة من الخارج؛ الأزقة المحيطة والأذان ما زالا يشكّلان المشهد الصوتي.
overview.p2: اجمع توقفاً محترماً خارجياً مع الأسواق وأسراك. ارتدِ لباساً محتشماً قرب المواقع الدينية.

moods.title: Around the mosque through the day
moods.subtitle: Respect prayer times; streets shift with the religious rhythm.

1.title: Quieter lanes
1.desc: Good for exterior photos before the busiest market hours.

2.title: Prayer peaks
2.desc: Give space to worshippers; avoid blocking entrances.

3.title: Soft evening air
3.desc: Pleasant for a short medina walk after the heat drops.

food.title: الأكل في المنطقة
food.p1: Medina cafés and simple restaurants are close. Keep noise and dress respectful in the immediate vicinity.
food.p2: Fuller meals are easy toward Assarag.
food.li3: Avoid eating at the mosque door.

1.title: Access
1.desc: Non-Muslims should not enter prayer halls unless explicitly invited; exterior viewing is the norm.

2.title: Dress
2.desc: Covered shoulders and knees show respect in the medina.

3.title: Photos
3.desc: Ask before photographing people; avoid intrusive shots during prayer.

q1.question: Can I go inside?
q1.answer: Generally exterior only for non-Muslims — follow local practice.

q2.question: Is it a tourist monument?
q2.answer: It is an active mosque first; visit with respect.

q3.question: Time needed?
q3.answer: Fifteen to thirty minutes for the exterior and nearby lanes.

q4.question: Combine with souks?
q4.answer: Yes — they sit in the same medina fabric.

q5.question: Best behaviour tip?
q5.answer: Stay quiet near entrances during prayer times.

a2.title: مشي الأسوار
a2.desc: كيف تستمتع بالأسوار المغرة دون الحر.
